sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Farhan Alam Osmany Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Neeraj Tiwari,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Anant Pratap Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the charge sheet dated 16.8.2023 as well as summoning order dated 19.7.2024 and entire proceeding of Criminal Case No. 33290 of 2024 (State vs. Salman @ Maan), arising out of case crime No.0374 of 2023, under Sections- 498A,
323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Pihani, District- Barabanki.

3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the husband as well as entire family members of the husband-applicant no. 1 have been falsely implicated in the present case by the opposite party Salman @ Maan And 7 Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

5. From the perusal of the material on record and looking into the facts of the case at this stage it cannot be said that no offence is made out against the applicants.

7. C.B.I. & Another, passed in S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, judgement dated 11.7.2022.
8.

9. With the aforesaid directions, this application is finally disposed of so far as applicant no. 1 is concerned.
10. So far as the applicant nos. 2 to 8 are concerned the following order is being passed:-
11. Learned A.G.A. prays for and is granted four weeks time to file counter affidavit.
The opposite party no. 2 may also file counter affidavit within the said period.
As prayed by the learned counsel for the applicants two weeks thereafter is granted for filing rejoinder affidavit.

12. List this case on 25.1.2025.
13.
Till the next date of listing, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant nos.2 to 8 in the aforesaid case.
